test_strategy: Adopt a layered testing approach combining unit testing (Jest) for service logic and middleware, integration testing for PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs using msw or nock stubs, and full E2E tests using Playwright against the Next.js UI to validate workflows (search, drilldown, refund, approvals, alerts, export). Security tests cover RBAC enforcement and mTLS/OAuth2 authentication. Performance/load tests ensure SLA (<1.5s search, <4s payouts). Kafka and S3 audit verifications included in integration scope.

test_cases.title: Merchant and batch search responsiveness
test_cases.description: Verify that merchants and payment batches can be searched across ACH, RTP, and WIRE rails within defined performance SLA.
preconditions: OpsAnalyst user logged in with proper RBAC role
System connected to PaymentCore GraphQL replica
test_cases.expected_result: Search results render correctly with total count and pagination within 1.5 seconds.

test_cases.title: Settlement timeline drilldown view
test_cases.description: Validate that selecting a payment batch retrieves timeline and transaction details from PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST.
test_cases.expected_result: Timeline displays chronological events with timestamps and statuses returned under 1.5s latency.

test_cases.title: Refund initiation for eligible payment
test_cases.description: Check refund trigger via Payment Actions and confirm audit logs emission to Kafka and S3.
steps: Call POST /api/payments/:paymentId/refund with reason and amount
test_cases.expected_result: API returns refundId with success status, Kafka receives audit event, and S3 archive file exists.

test_cases.title: Refund initiation negative - unauthorized role
test_cases.description: Ensure RBAC restriction blocks refund for Auditor role.
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 403 returned, no audit event emitted.

test_cases.title: Approve payout batch with automated allocation
test_cases.description: Validate payout approval functionality and audit logging for Manager role.
steps: Call POST /api/payouts/:batchId/approve with managerId and allocationPolicy
test_cases.expected_result: Approval recorded successfully, allocation applied, audit message emitted to Kafka and archived in S3.

test_cases.title: Approve payout negative - OpsAnalyst role
test_cases.description: Ensure non-manager users cannot perform approval.
test_cases.expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403; no approval or audit log created.

test_cases.title: Display anomaly alerts in dashboard
test_cases.description: Confirm that Payment Rail event stream anomalies appear in the dashboard with merchant and batch details.
preconditions: Payment Rail event stream contains anomalies
test_cases.expected_result: Alerts displayed correctly with message, severity, and timestamp information.

test_cases.title: Export audit-ready payment report
test_cases.description: Verify auditor can export CSV/JSON report to S3 and receive valid download URL.
steps: Call GET /api/reports/export with date range and format
Inspect response for downloadUrl and archivedTo
Check S3 bucket for file presence
test_cases.expected_result: Report generated and archived with proper IAM policy, audit event logged.

test_cases.title: Search edge case - non-existent merchant
test_cases.description: Validate that empty result returned gracefully when merchantName does not exist.
test_cases.expected_result: Empty results array, no errors, response time <1.5s.

test_cases.title: Performance test - payout round-trip time
test_cases.description: Measure payout initiation and approval round-trip latency requirement (<4s).
test_cases.expected_result: Total time from request to response <4s with successful status.

test_cases.title: Audit event integrity validation
test_cases.description: Ensure audit payload matches schema and timestamp correctness.
preconditions: Kafka and S3 event available after refund or approval action
test_cases.expected_result: Audit event JSON consistent across Kafka and S3 with valid timestamp and action fields.

test_data_requirements: Merchant records across ACH, RTP, WIRE rails
Sample payment batches with transactions in various statuses (Pending, Approved, Refunded)
Mock PaymentCore GraphQL responses for search and timeline
Mock Payment Rail REST endpoints for refund and approval actions
Kafka test topic setup for audit events
S3 test bucket for archival verification
User accounts mapped to RBAC roles (OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor)
automation_approach: Utilize Jest for unit and integration testing with mocks (nock/msw) for API calls, Playwright for E2E UI tests validating behavior and performance. Kafka audit event verification scripted via kafkajs consumer in Jest tests. Include CI/CD integration triggering automated test pipelines on merge. Load tests via k6 or Artillery targeting SLA metrics. Ensure fixtures and test data reset through Docker Compose for isolated environments.
coverage_goals: Achieve 90% unit test coverage across backend controllers and middleware, 100% verification of all RBAC roles and workflows (search, drilldown, refund, approval, alerts, export). Integration tests to validate API interoperability and audit pipeline end-to-end. E2E test suite ensures functional parity with PO story acceptance criteria and performance SLA adherence across UI and backend.
